entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? Oh, hi... I, uh, I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with that. Could I please have your order number to start?
Yes, it's VF-8675-3091. It's for the cycling shoes I bought. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've ever had a problem.

Thank you for that, and I'm very sorry to hear you're having an issue. I see the order for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered about 52 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit... they just hurt so much. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks... but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. I was so excited for them, and I really needed this money back if they didn't work out. I just feel so let down.

I can absolutely understand how frustrating and painful blisters can be, especially when you're looking forward to a new pair of shoes. It sounds like a comfort and fit issue rather than a defect. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.
Okay... I just hope you can help. I saved up for these.

Alright, I've got it here. Since your purchase was 52 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can definitely process a full refund for you. There's no problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you a prepaid shipping label to your email on file now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Does that sound good?
That sounds perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
